title: feat(nm2frm1spy): directed 1-step cyclic-frame transport along +e2 at t+1 on two-axis opposite seed: reverse fails, face fails
science: +e2 1-step, two-axis opposite, GLOBAL tau=1. DEFECT: the note states the cut as 'Let t(q) be the formation tick. The cut is tau=t+1' — a per-site rule — but the runner reads every site, including destinations with t>0, at tau=1. Under the note's own rule this cell is reverse=HOLD, not fail; I recomputed both. Reported bits are the same sequence ('hold','fail') for reverse and for face, a coincidence the note does not flag.
